title: Nadella clarifies voluntary buyout program amid shift to agent-driven development
summary: Microsoft offered voluntary exit options to eligible employees as software development transitions toward compact teams managing artificial intelligence agents, clarifying that the move provides agency during restructuring rather than forced mass layoffs.
research_notes:
Structure software engineering groups into compact teams that direct and validate autonomous agents rather than expanding manual programming headcount.

Transition developer responsibilities from writing line-by-line implementation code to managing, orchestrating, and evaluating artificial intelligence agent outputs.
